package main

import "runtime"

type Obj struct{ data [512]byte }
type Holder struct{ Ref *Obj }

var keep *Obj

func main() {
	func() {
		o := &Obj{}
		// The closure captures o, so o is reachable from its own finalizer.
		runtime.SetFinalizer(o, func(*Obj) { _ = o })
	}()
	runtime.GC()
	runtime.GC()
}
